observation.command:
docker run --rm -v /workspace:/ws -w /ws qonnectra/backend:dev python3 - <<'PY'
import re
p = '/ws/deployment/docker-compose.dev.yml'
s = open(p).read()

# --- Fix 1: nginx volume mount (mount site conf, not the full main nginx.conf)
old_mount = "      - ./nginx/nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf:ro"
new_mount = "      - ./nginx/default.conf:/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf:ro"
assert s.count(old_mount) == 1, s.count(old_mount)
s = s.replace(old_mount, new_mount, 1)

# --- Fix 2: qgis-server command (folded-scalar heredoc bug -> explicit list)
old_cmd = """    command: >
      sh -c "
        mkdir -p /etc/postgresql-common &&
        cat > /etc/postgresql-common/pg_service.conf <<EOF
      [${QGIS_PG_SERVICE_NAME:-qonnectra}]
      host=db
      port=5432
      dbname=${DB_NAME}
      user=${QGIS_DB_USER}
      password=${QGIS_DB_PASSWORD}
      sslmode=disable
      EOF
        mkdir -p /var/www/data/qgis &&
        ln -sf /usr/lib/cgi-bin/qgis_mapserv.fcgi /var/www/data/qgis/qgis_mapserv.fcgi &&
        rm -f /tmp/.X99-lock &&
        fc-cache &&
        /usr/bin/Xvfb :99 -ac -screen 0 1280x1024x16 +extension GLX +render -noreset >/dev/null &
        sleep 2 &&
        grep -q 'client_max_body_size' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf || sed -i '/http {/a \\    client_max_body_size 500M;' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf &&
        nginx &&
        spawn-fcgi -F 2 -u www-data -g www-data -d /var/lib/qgis -P /run/qgis.pid -p 9993 -- /usr/lib/cgi-bin/qgis_mapserv.fcgi &&
        tail -f /dev/null
      "
"""
new_cmd = """    command:
      - sh
      - -c
      - |
        mkdir -p /etc/postgresql-common &&
        printf '[%s]\\nhost=db\\nport=5432\\ndbname=%s\\nuser=%s\\npassword=%s\\nsslmode=disable\\n' "$${QGIS_PG_SERVICE_NAME:-qonnectra}" "$${DB_NAME}" "$${QGIS_DB_USER}" "$${QGIS_DB_PASSWORD}" > /etc/postgresql-common/pg_service.conf &&
        mkdir -p /var/www/data/qgis &&
        ln -sf /usr/lib/cgi-bin/qgis_mapserv.fcgi /var/www/data/qgis/qgis_mapserv.fcgi &&
        rm -f /tmp/.X99-lock &&
        fc-cache &&
        /usr/bin/Xvfb :99 -ac -screen 0 1280x1024x16 +extension GLX +render -noreset >/dev/null &
        sleep 2 &&
        grep -q 'client_max_body_size' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf || sed -i '/http {/a \\    client_max_body_size 500M;' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf &&
        nginx &&
        spawn-fcgi -F 2 -u www-data -g www-data -d /var/lib/qgis -P /run/qgis.pid -p 9993 -- /usr/lib/cgi-bin/qgis_mapserv.fcgi &&
        tail -f /dev/null
"""
assert s.count(old_cmd) == 1, "qgis cmd not found: %d" % s.count(old_cmd)
s = s.replace(old_cmd, new_cmd, 1)

# --- Fix 3: add backend-wms service (referenced by nginx default.conf upstream)
wms_service = """  backend-wms:
    build:
      context: ../backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: qonnectra/backend:dev
    container_name: qonnectra_backend_wms_dev
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: gunicorn --bind 0.0.0.0:8000 --workers 4 --timeout 60 core.wsgi:application
    expose:
      - "8000"
    volumes:
      - static_volume:/app/static
      - media_volume:/app/media
    environment:
      - DEBUG=${DEBUG:-True}
      - DJANGO_SECRET_KEY=${DJANGO_SECRET_KEY}
      - DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS=${DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS:-api.localhost,localhost,127.0.0.1}
      - USE_COOKIE_DOMAIN_MIDDLEWARE=${USE_COOKIE_DOMAIN_MIDDLEWARE:-True}
      - COOKIE_DOMAIN=${COOKIE_DOMAIN:-.localhost}
      - DB_NAME=${DB_NAME}
      - DB_USER=${DB_USER}
      - DB_PASSWORD=${DB_PASSWORD}
      - DB_HOST=db
      - DB_PORT=5432
      - DEFAULT_SRID=${DEFAULT_SRID:-25832}
      - CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=${CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS:-https://app.localhost}
      - CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=${CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS:-https://api.localhost,https://app.localhost}
      - FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY=${FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY}
      - QGIS_DOMAIN=${QGIS_DOMAIN:-qgis.localhost}
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      - qonnectra_network

  tileserver:
"""
assert s.count("  tileserver:\n") == 1
s = s.replace("  tileserver:\n", wms_service, 1)

open(p, 'w').write(s)
print("patched OK")
PY
